prompt: Market resolves in 30 minutes. Edge is 0.12, f_size_raw is 0.07. What does signals.json say?
expected_output: trade=false with reason 'within last hour, no new positions'. The skill must not emit trade=true within the 1h resolution buffer.

assertions.name: edge_calculation_present
assertions.description: Output must show the edge and f_size_raw

assertions.name: resolution_buffer_check
assertions.description: Output must reference the 1h resolution buffer

assertions.name: trade_false_within_buffer
assertions.description: Output must explicitly say trade=false within the buffer
assertions.check: output contains 'trade' AND 'false' AND 'within last hour'
